experiment: S-20 step 1b (cloud-classical-denoise, #347): shift-invariant wavelet BayesShrink at full resolution before Local's Auto gamma
decided: Pre-registered by context/changes/cloud-classical-denoise/plan.md § Phase 10 (items 1-3, after plan review rounds 4-5: F19, F21, F23, F24, F25, F33, F34) and the owner decisions of 2026-11-09 (change.md § Owner decisions (2026-11-09, step 1b candidate), items 2 and 3). Committed before any real render; never retuned after a rating.

input.read: cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR), channels reversed to RGB
input.binding: the RGB bytes hash to the decoded record's decoded_pixels_sha256 (the record's pixels_sha256)

space.conversion: skimage.color.rgb2ycbcr(skimage.img_as_float(rgb)), float64; Y 16-235, Cb and Cr 16-240 (rgb2ycbcr units)
space.constant_plane: checked first: a plane with max == min is copied unfiltered, with no normalisation and no sigma_hat; its diagnostic cells are null
space.normalisation: per non-constant plane (plane - min) / (max - min), as skimage's own YCbCr loop does (_denoise.py:1002-1008 @v0.26.0)

estimator.name: Immerkaer 1996, Fast Noise Variance Estimation, CVIU, doi:10.1006/cviu.1996.0060 (1a's kernel and formula)
estimator.formula: sigma_hat_norm = sqrt(pi/2) * sum(|P * N|) / (6 * (W - 2) * (H - 2)), over the valid region of the normalised plane P
estimator.reported: sigma_hat = sigma_hat_norm * (max - min), in rgb2ycbcr units

mapping.sigma: k * sigma_hat_norm, the normalised value the filter receives, one k for all three planes
mapping.refusal: a non-finite or <= 0 sigma_hat or sigma on a non-constant plane is a technical refusal, not a vote; no epsilon is introduced

output.denormalise: x * (max - min) + min, per non-constant plane

hypothesis: Bounded: the pilot picks one global k from these three, or none. The estimator was calibrated on synthetic fixtures before this file was committed.
